title: Trump and Xi meet, but hopes for AI cooperation stay slim
summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping and US President Donald Trump have been holding talks in the Oval Office at the White House. Trump gave the visiting leader of Communist China a personal tour of several of his favourite White House features. He took him aboard the Marine One helicopter, presented the new granite landing pad he had built for it, and pointed out the massive adjacent construction site where a ballroom will eventually stand.

title: Chinese Yuan: PBoC keeps yuan broadly stable – Societe Generale
summary: Societe Generale describes a limited impact from President Xi’s US visit, with no new tariff cuts or AI dialogue mechanism agreed as the trade truce was only extended to January.

title: The future of AI in their hands? Trump-Xi summit dismisses calls for global oversight
summary: It's their AI world and we're just living in it. If that's the feeling of those who suffer from AI anxiety, it may worsen watching the Chinese president's first state visit to Washington in nine years. If there's one issue that the planet's biggest superpowers agree on, it's that now is not the time for global regulation of artificial intelligence. As they sit down to a White House state dinner just hours after news that OpenAI had hacked the Australian government, we ask who will call to task the US tech titans at the table.

title: Iran threatens widespread disruption as Iraq halts Iran flights
summary: Iraq has suspended Iranian flights at all four airports where they operated
